# Acknowledge align assure

`customer_support.df.de_escalation.acknowledge_align_assure` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **decision_framework**

> Acknowledge — Align — Assure: name what happened in their words, agree what matters most to them right now, commit to the next contact.

The Align step is the one that gets skipped and the one that carries the value. What matters most to the customer is frequently not the fix — it may be a workaround before a board meeting, or something they can forward — and assuming otherwise produces a perfectly executed response to the wrong priority.
